data.narrative:
Field AI is a Series B AI & Software company founded by Ali Agha and Shayegan Omidshafiei, currently valued at $2.0B post-money with $405M total raised. The peer universe comprises 7 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables spanning private rounds, with valuations ranging from $3.25B to $39.0B, alongside one public reference point (Palantir).

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical for Series B advancement, implying $3.8B. Peer-median triangulation across the 7-company cohort yields a $10.0B median, reflecting substantial dispersion: Figure AI at $39.0B (Series C), Reflection AI at $25.0B (Series A), and Skild AI at $14.0B (Series C) represent the upper range, while the distribution floor sits at $3.2B. The peer set spans different stage maturity, which accounts for valuation width.

Synthesizing both methods produces a triangulated range of $3.2B (low) to $11.5B (high), with a median of $6.9B. The $2.0B current valuation sits below this range, suggesting upside potential typical of Series B repricing. Key uncertainties include stage-adjusted peer selection—the cohort spans Series A through C—and the outsized influence of high-valued outliers (Figure AI, Reflection AI) on median positioning. Revenue, growth rate, and capital efficiency metrics would sharpen conviction in this range.
